# Contributing

Thanks for taking a look.

Most repositories here are personal tools, lab notes, experiments, or security infrastructure snippets. Contributions are welcome where they make the project clearer, safer, or more useful.

## Good contributions

- Bug fixes
- Documentation improvements
- Safer defaults
- Simpler examples
- ShellCheck/yamllint fixes
- Better error handling
- Small focused features

## Before opening a PR

Please try to keep changes focused.

Good:

- One bug fix
- One new script
- One documentation cleanup
- One workflow improvement

Less good:

- Large unrelated rewrites
- Style-only churn across many files
- New dependencies without a clear reason

## Style

Prefer:

- Clear names
- Plain text
- Small scripts
- Useful comments
- Defensive shell scripting
- Examples that can be copied and tested

## Security

Do not commit secrets, real credentials, private IP ranges from sensitive environments, customer data, or exploit material that could create unnecessary risk.

For security issues, see `SECURITY.md`.
